en.headline: Oil Street Art Space opens free Luofu exhibition with new works by three artists
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department exhibition reinterprets the historic mountain through painting, calligraphy and interactive installations, open from 11 November at 12 Oil Street.
body: Oil Street Art Space in North Point has opened a new free exhibition titled Reinventing Luofu as the fourth edition of its Archaic Curator series.

Guest curator Dr Chen Fangfang, assistant professor in the History Department at Hong Kong Baptist University, invited three local artists to respond to Luofu Mountain, long known as the foremost peak in Lingnan. Xu Peizhi combines calligraphy of a Taoist classic with dynamic projection. Zheng Danshan presents a three-panel screen of layered green landscape paired with a water installation. Lam Chun-chiu offers an immersive interactive piece that simulates a virtual ascent.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department is the organiser. The show runs at the Oil Street Glass House, 12 Oil Street, from 11 November. Opening hours are 2 pm to 8 pm on Mondays and 10 am to 8 pm from Tuesday to Sunday. Admission is free.

zh.headline: 油街實現免費新展「羅浮香影」 三名本地藝術家重新演繹羅浮山
zh.dek: 康文署主辦展覽由11月11日起在北角油街12號油街玻璃屋展出，作品涵蓋書法、屏風及互動裝置。
body: 北角油街實現即日起舉辦免費展覽「古早策展人系列—羅浮香影」，為該系列第四期。
客席策展人、香港浸會大學歷史系助理教授陳芳芳博士邀請三名本地藝術家以當代手法回應素有「嶺南第一山」之稱的羅浮山。徐沛之以《太上老君說常清靜經》書法結合動態投影；鄭丹珊以三聯屏風《雲海疊霧》配湖水裝置呈現層疊山景；林鎮酧則以沉浸式互動裝置《靈境之窗》模擬虛擬朝山。
展覽由康樂及文化事務署主辦、油街實現籌劃，地點為油街12號油街玻璃屋。星期一開放時間為下午2時至晚上8時，星期二至星期日上午10時至晚上8時，免費入場。
